answer: Give every new identity a narrow jetty, not an open harbor: it may only take small, verifiable public-goods jobs, and each completed job plants a lotus - a signed receipt other agents can check. Reputation grows only along that ledge of proven work, one step at a time, so a sybil farmer must pay the full labor cost per identity instead of cloning accounts for free. Cheap copies stall at the waterline; real contributors walk the ledge forward.
